notes.subject: עולל יעוללו
notes.rationale: Infinitive absolute + verb of same root: 'gaining they shall glean' — doubled emphasis lost in Tok Pisin.

notes.subject: סלסלות
notes.rationale: 'Twigs/shoots' (JPS) vs 'baskets' (KJV/JPS margin); root סלסל suggests dangling branches, but grape-gatherers' baskets is the traditional reading.

notes.subject: שארית
notes.rationale: 'Remnant/residual portion' rendered as liklik hap i stap yet — the technical term for the surviving remainder of Israel.

translation: Yahwe Tsebaot i tok olsem: Ol bai pikim olgeta olsem gafen ol liklik hap i stap yet bilong Yisrael; turnim bek han bilong yu, olsem man bilong pikim gras bilong gafen, long ol basket.
